versions.name: The Reflection
versions.text: Need: 30 or more monsters in both dustpiles. Magic: Set the enemy's max HP to their current (max. 15).

versions.name: The Reflection
versions.text: Need: 40 or more monsters in both Dustpiles. Magic: Burn them to add a copy of the enemy hand to your deck (except DT cards).
versions.note: Also includes Beta 69.1, Beta 73.1, Beta 74.1 (the tracker saw them together).
